bullets: Added GPT-6 Luna and MiMo 2.6 Pro to full access for all Freebuff users, removing the previous US-or-paid restriction while remaining plan-only for limited-tier accounts.
Fixed sponsored runs to refuse WSL launchers, destructive database commands, and container lifecycle commands that could affect the user's environment.
Narrowed codebase evaluation to connected GitHub repositories only and updated data-use policy text accordingly.
Added support for sponsored runs to declare and receive per-run credentials isolated from the model and injected only into the task environment.
Updated Linux clipboard copy to show a hint suggesting wl-clipboard or xclip when copying only works via terminal fallback.
Added a new partner ad slot format and dedicated partner placements, excluding them from ordinary self-service advertiser targeting.
Added automatic resume of a stale legacy pre-multi-session free hour across CLI restarts and binary updates.
Fixed Codebuff own-credits 401 errors to no longer be misreported as Freebuff provider problems.
Fixed SDK history truncation to count only user prompts and elide large base64 content from summarization.
Added CLI fatal crash reporting that records reports and sends them on the next launch.
Updated the session-ended banner fallback model name to 'DeepSeek V4.1 Flash'.
Replaced the /reasoning slash command with /model and moved model selection and session admission into inline chat controls.
